capabilities: Search emoji by fuzzy or semantic match
Insert emoji by click or arrow keys plus enter
Toggle Twitter emoji image formatting for preview and insert
disambiguation: Not a persistent toolbar; it opens a searchable emoji picker from a hotkey.
extras: Makes no network requests by default; enabling Twitter Emoji loads emoji images from the jsDelivr CDN in the picker and reading view.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in searchable emoji picker, so inserting an emoji means leaving the editor or recalling input shortcuts.
summary: Hotkey-driven emoji picker that searches emoji by word and inserts the chosen one into the editor by click or keyboard.
